B-gmm.hinglish: to aap kiska dena hai ji uski ka vote dena hai ji aage samay badhaega vikas karaega hum log ka indirabad ho bathroom ho sahara ho mana jo bhi cheez ke sahara ho

B-pyannote.hinglish: naya wastr kharid ke late hain pahante hain usmen
